event.title: Marching to Independence: Lancaster Soldiers at the Battle of Fort Lee
event.description: How did ordinary men from Lancaster County end up on the front lines of the American Revolution? Step back in time with living historian Samuel Leamer to uncover the harrowing story of Clotz's Battalion-- part of the legendary "Flying Camp" mobile reserve. Relive the tension of November 1776 at the Battle of Fort Lee, discover the courageous stories of local soldiers fighting for a brand-new nation, and see how modern historians uncover the past to keep their legacy alive. Don't miss this immersive journey into the fight for independence! Registration is encouraged! A Berks County native and Cairn University history graduate, Presenter Sam Leamer has spent a lifetime bringing the past to life through reenactments-- and a decade mastering the art of modern coffee. By blending historical scholarship with coffee expertise, Sam offers a richer, deeper look into Colonial Coffee Culture, showing how the humble coffee bean helped fuel America’s fight for independence.
